fullDescription: A premium dual-theme developer portfolio featuring a high-end editorial aesthetic. The design alternates between a 'Warm Ivory Editorial' light mode (#F9F8F6) and an 'Onyx and Champagne' dark mode (#0B0C0E). It utilizes a sophisticated typographic hierarchy pairing elegant serifs (Crimson Pro) with modern sans-serifs (Plus Jakarta Sans) and technical monospaced fonts (JetBrains Mono). The layout is characterized by asymmetric grid structures, generous whitespace, thin hairline borders, and understated gold accents (#9E7B4F / #D4AF37). Ideal for software engineers, AI researchers, cybersecurity professionals, and luxury tech brands requiring a minimalist yet authoritative digital presence.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dual-theme portfolio design that transitions from a light luxury magazine aesthetic to a cinematic tech dark mode, utilizing high-contrast accents and rigorous grid layouts.

style.description: The design aesthetic is 'Modern Editorial.' It relies on three distinct font categories: high-contrast serifs for large headlines, clean sans-serif for readable body copy, and monospaced fonts for metadata and technical labels. The color palette is restricted to ivory/onyx foundations with metallic gold highlights. UI elements use thin 1px borders and very subtle radial-gradient background patterns instead of heavy shadows or gradients.
style.prompt: Create a UI with a dual-theme system. Light Theme: Background #F9F8F6, Text #111111, Accents #9E7B4F, Borders #E5E0D8, Secondary Text #66615A. Dark Theme: Background #0B0C0E, Text #F3F1EC, Accents #D4AF37, Borders #303139, Secondary Text #A6A6A6. Typography: Headlines in 'Crimson Pro' (weights 300, 400, 600), UI/Body in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 400, 600), and labels in 'JetBrains Mono' (tracking-widest). Use a 40px radial-gradient dot pattern (opacity 0.2 in light, 0.05 in dark) for hero backgrounds. Borders must be strictly 1px. Transitions should use 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Shadows should be minimal (editorial-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)).

layout_and_structure.description: A multi-section landing page using a fixed navigation bar, asymmetric hero, and modular grid systems for skills and projects. The design favors vertical rhythm and wide margins (max-width: 1280px).

prompts.prompt: Fixed 80px height bar with backdrop-blur (80% opacity). Left: Monogram logo in serif bold + uppercase monospaced 'DEVELOPER' label separated by a vertical 1px line. Center: Hidden on mobile, text-xs uppercase links with 0.25em letter spacing. Right: Circular theme toggle (lucide:sun/moon) and a rectangular 'Resume' button with 10px bold uppercase text and wide tracking.

Asymmetric layout (8:4 grid ratio). Left: Mono label with a horizontal line accent, followed by a massive 8xl serif headline with specific italic highlights for emphasis. Subtext is max-width 24rem. Right: A decorative code-snippet window (w-64 h-96) with thin borders and an L-shaped gold accent bracket in the bottom-left corner.

Three-column modular grid where cards are separated by a 1px gap showing the background border color. Each card (p-10) contains a top row with title and icon, followed by specific skill rows with 1px bottom borders. Skill rows include the name on the left and a monospaced proficiency label (e.g., 'Advanced') on the right.

Two-column staggered grid. The second card is offset vertically (e.g., mt-24) to create an editorial flow. Cards feature a 16:10 aspect ratio image container with a subtle 700ms scale hover effect. Metadata includes monospaced category labels in gold, a serif title, and GitHub/External icons.

High-impact section with a inverted theme (dark background even in light mode). Left: 7xl serif headline with 'extraordinary' in light italics. Right: Two-column link list for social and navigation links, with a bottom-aligned copyright and a circular 'Back to Top' arrow button.

special_ui_components.description: A circular icon button that switches between sun and moon icons with a 0.4s fade and rotation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Button: p-2, rounded-full, transition-colors. Icon: iconify-icon lucide:sun (visible in light) / lucide:moon (visible in dark). Smoothly transition colors of the entire DOM using CSS variables: --bg, --text, --accent, --border.

special_ui_components.description: A sophisticated card layout prioritizing typography over heavy containers.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: group, relative. Image: aspect-[16/10], bg-grey-warm, overflow-hidden, 0.8 opacity. Content: mt-8. Category: font-mono, text-[10px], uppercase, gold-antique. Title: font-serif, text-2xl. Tags: border, text-[9px], font-bold, tracking-widest, px-3, py-1. Hover: Image scales 1.05x, icons change to accent color.
